statement: For exact prepared|++>,every ideal conclusive fine record gives the same corrected Bell pair;timeout q^M changes yield,not ideal accepted marginal purity. Older source-correlated quantum information can be steered by selecting a fine record;coarse accepted joint-history comparison retains delta=q^M+epsilon_M and normalized delta/(1-delta). Reported witness has pure new Bell but joint source/reference difference~.0125 after one sweep. Temporal odd test is X2/native/X2 on EVERY branch;for Bell generation its post-click returnX and odd-to-even Bell correction cancel only together,with known Z1 tracked. Expected physical sweeps<=g_M+(eta_s/p)(M-g_M),g_M=(1-q^M)/p. Arbitrarily small absorbing faults can make uncapped expectation infinite. Fixed-deadline storage costs full time after success. Weak T gives p=O(b^2T^2),eta=O(e^2T^2),so eta/p=O(e^2/b^2) while expected interrogation time grows1/(b^2T);fixed readout errors worsen. Joint instruments telescope with memory,not IID resets.
